courses.title: HTML Complete Course
courses.description: Learn the complete fundamentals of HTML from scratch. Understand how the web works, create beautiful pages, and build strong foundations for your web development journey.
learningOutcomes: Understand how the web works, including servers, clients, and browsers.
Learn the structure and syntax of HTML5.
Use headings, links, lists, and tables effectively.
Build interactive forms with validation.
Implement accessibility and SEO-friendly practices.
Work with media (audio, video, and embeds).
Understand metadata, favicons, and SEO optimization.
Build a complete multi-page responsive website using HTML and CSS.

courses.title: CSS Mastery Course
courses.description: Master the art of styling web pages using CSS3. Learn layouts, animations, flexbox, grid, responsive design, and how to build beautiful modern websites.
learningOutcomes: Understand how CSS works and how to link it to HTML files.
Learn about selectors, combinators, pseudo-classes, and pseudo-elements.
Master the CSS box model, positioning, and display properties.
Build responsive layouts using Flexbox and CSS Grid.
Use CSS variables, transitions, and keyframe animations.
Learn media queries for adaptive and mobile-first design.
Implement hover effects and UI components.
Build a professional portfolio website using HTML and CSS.

courses.title: JavaScript Essentials
courses.description: A complete guide to modern JavaScript from scratch — covering syntax, DOM manipulation, and real-world projects.
learningOutcomes: Understand variables, data types, and operators.
Work with arrays, objects, and functions.
Manipulate the DOM dynamically.
Handle events and user interactions.
Understand asynchronous programming and Promises.
Use ES6 features effectively.
Build small interactive projects using JS.

courses.title: React JS for Beginners
courses.description: Learn to build dynamic, component-based web applications using React.
learningOutcomes: Understand component-based architecture.
Use JSX to structure UI elements.
Learn props, state, and lifecycle methods.
Use React Hooks for functional components.
Handle routing with React Router.
Fetch data using APIs in React.
Deploy React apps to the web.

courses.title: Node.js and Express Course
courses.description: Build fast and scalable backend servers using Node.js and Express framework.
learningOutcomes: Set up a Node.js development environment.
Understand the core concepts of Node.js.
Work with Express.js to create RESTful APIs.
Handle routing, middleware, and errors.
Connect Node.js to databases like MongoDB.
Build authentication and authorization systems.
Deploy Node.js applications to production.

courses.title: Python Programming Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn the Python programming language for automation, data, and web applications.
learningOutcomes: Understand Python syntax and indentation.
Learn loops, conditionals, and data types.
Work with functions, modules, and packages.
Handle file I/O operations.
Create small automation scripts.
Use Python libraries for data and web apps.

courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp
courses.description: Become a full-stack web developer by learning both frontend and backend technologies.
learningOutcomes: Build frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Develop backend APIs using Node.js and Express.
Store data using MongoDB.
Integrate frontend and backend.
Deploy full-stack apps to the cloud.

courses.title: UI/UX Design Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn design thinking, wireframing, and prototyping to create user-friendly interfaces.
learningOutcomes: Understand the principles of good design.
Learn to use Figma and Adobe XD.
Create wireframes and prototypes.
Understand color theory and typography.
Design user-friendly interfaces.

courses.title: Database Management with SQL
courses.description: Learn how to design, query, and manage relational databases using SQL.
learningOutcomes: Understand relational database concepts.
Learn SQL queries (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY).
Work with MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Design normalized database schemas.
Use indexes and constraints effectively.

courses.title: Web Hosting & Deployment Course
courses.description: Learn how to host, secure, and deploy web applications to the cloud efficiently.
learningOutcomes: Understand domain registration and DNS.
Learn about cloud deployment (AWS, Netlify).
Use GitHub for version control.
Implement CI/CD pipelines.
Secure web servers and optimize performance.
